user.title: HA Apps
user.description: Installs the Supervisor-free add-on store. Requires the ha-apps CLI at /usr/local/bin/ha-apps and Docker on the host.

panel.catalog_empty: Catalog is empty — click "Refresh catalog" to fetch the add-on repositories.
panel.catalog_failed: Catalog could not be loaded (see console).
panel.sup_hassio_api: calls Supervisor APIs — the built-in stub answers the boot calls, more complex features may be missing
panel.sup_hassio_role: requests elevated Supervisor privileges — ignored here, the add-on may check for them
panel.sup_homeassistant_api: wants the Home Assistant API via the Supervisor proxy — real calls will likely fail
panel.sup_services: expects other add-ons as services (service discovery) — not available without a real Supervisor
panel.sup_discovery: uses discovery messages — not available without a real Supervisor
panel.sup_auth_api: wants real user authentication — will fail
panel.sup_docker_api: wants to spawn containers itself — the Docker socket is not available
panel.sup_unknown: not covered by the stub — functionality uncertain
panel.warn_tail: It may start but will probably only work partially — or not at all.
panel.ok_no_deps: ✅ No Supervisor dependencies detected — good prospects.
panel.disk_low_title: Below {min} MB free — installations are blocked
panel.sup_badge_title: Uses Supervisor APIs ({keys}) — may be limited
panel.verified_title: Tested with auto-setup — will be fully configured
